findings.why: Heat H-4471 of BR-220 needs an EN 10204 3.1 certificate showing EN AW-6082-T6 and the SC-01 yield result (>= 250 MPa). The control plan checks this before each lot is released to production. None of the documents holds a certificate or tensile result for H-4471, so a person must supply it before release. The source approval AP-0311 (BR-220, TO1, STL, Alluminio B, 6082-T6, Rev C) is current, so no source-release finding applies.
